info.title: Nivult Job Postings & Company Intelligence
info.description: Live job postings collected directly from employer ATS systems (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, SmartRecruiters and 60+ more) plus national employment portals — enriched with technology stack, seniority, remote policy, salary and language requirements. One record per employer in /v1/companies, with industry and size. Updated continuously; closures are verified against the source. Browse is cheap, freshness is the product.

get.description: Active job postings from employer ATS sources. Keyset pagination: follow next_cursor until null. Filters: country (ISO-2), technology, ats platform, category, seniority, remote, language, free-text q on title and description, and posted_after (or its dal alias).

get.summary: The delta feed: new, updated, closed
get.description: New postings, full updated snapshots and verified closures since a timestamp. Delta history is retained for 7 days. Direct API keys require an account monthly tier of at least 200,000 credits; purchased top-ups do not raise this entitlement. RapidAPI plans are not subject to the direct-account tier check.

parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; must not predate retention_since
